name: forge-marketplace
description: Forge Mentor and related decide-then-code tooling for Claude Code.

plugins.name: forge
plugins.description: Forge Mentor — decide-then-code. Teaches every load-bearing decision, records your choice, and blocks code from moving past a decision you have not made yet.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Companion to Forge, by Dietrich Gebert (MIT). Gets an agent to write the least code that works: does this need writing, does the project already do it, does the standard library do it. Forge loads it at the build and review steps when it is installed, and runs without it when it is not.
